# LilysAI

> > LilysAI is an AI-powered workspace platform featuring Agent Lily, an intelligent assistant for content summarization, video analysis, and multi-step task automation, with deep integrations for Google Workspace, NotebookLM, and popular AI tools.

LilysAI helps users leverage AI for content creation, research, and workflow automation. The platform specializes in video summarization, note-taking with NotebookLM integration, and provides extensive tutorials on AI tools including ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Studio, and automation platforms like n8n.

## Key Topics

- Agent Lily
- NotebookLM
- Video summarization
- Content summarization
- Google AI Studio
- Gemini
- ChatGPT
- Workflow automation
- AI note-taking
- Google Workspace integration
- Beginner guides
- AI research assistant
- Custom GPTs
- n8n automation
- AI content creation
